stories.title: Ramp launches its own AI model router, called Router
stories.simple_summary: Ramp built a new tool that acts like a switchboard for different AI assistants — it lets you pick which AI you want to use instead of being locked into one.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech companies and developers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Meta brings Pocket, an app that lets you vibe-code and share games, to US users
stories.simple_summary: Meta is letting regular U.S. users make simple video games using AI, without needing to know how to code.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're curious about AI or want to tinker with game creation, this gives you a free way to try it.

stories.title: Inertia Enterprises finds a way to make its fusion fuel fast
stories.simple_summary: A company working on nuclear fusion power figured out how to fill their fuel tanks much faster — cutting the time from a week down to a few hours.
stories.why_it_matters: This is early-stage power research — nothing that affects your electricity bill or business yet.

stories.title: It’s Greg Brockman’s OpenAI now
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT, has had a tough year with lawsuits and drama as it prepares to go public.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Welcome to the AI crisis in math
stories.simple_summary: AI has become so good at solving math problems that it's created a crisis in the mathematics field, with mathematicians worried about what their work means now.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters to mathematicians and academics — nothing that affects everyday life or small business.

stories.title: Meta AI’s new Mac app wants you to talk to your apps
stories.simple_summary: Meta is making an app for Mac computers that lets you talk out loud to control your programs, instead of typing.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use a Mac and prefer speaking, this could save you time — similar to voice-to-text features you might already know.

stories.title: Slack is launching collaborative vibe-coding channels
stories.simple_summary: Slack is adding a feature where your whole team can work on code together with AI help all in one place, instead of switching between different tools.
stories.why_it_matters: If your small business has programmers or developers, this could make their work faster and less messy.

stories.title: Binance now lets AI agents trade, but keeping them in check is largely up to users
stories.simple_summary: Binance, a cryptocurrency exchange, now lets AI robots buy and sell coins automatically, but it's your responsibility to set them up safely.
stories.why_it_matters: Unless you trade cryptocurrency, this doesn't affect you — and it's risky even if you do.

stories.title: Stripe didn’t really buy OpenRouter because of the ‘singularity’
stories.simple_summary: Stripe, a company that handles online payments, bought a small company that helps route questions to different AI assistants.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI seeks to one-up Anthropic with new customer privacy protections
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI and another AI company called Anthropic are competing to offer better privacy protection for businesses that use their AI tools.
stories.why_it_matters: If your business uses AI and is concerned about data privacy, this competition means better protections for your information.

stories.title: Cognition CEO denies report that SpaceX tried to acquire the startup
stories.simple_summary: SpaceX did not buy Cognition, an AI company, despite rumors that they were trying to.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: AI was supposed to win people over by now — it hasn’t
stories.simple_summary: Even though AI is everywhere now, a lot of people are still skeptical and don't trust it yet.
stories.why_it_matters: You're not alone if you're hesitant about AI — many people share these concerns.
